Secure We are ISO27001 certified with high levels of system and data security IP protection Protect the intellectual property in your models Future-proof Faster implementation with flexible, future-ready architecture FAQs Do we need to rebuild our pricing models? No. Optalitix works with the models you already trust - including Excel, Python and R - turning them into secure, scalable APIs without rebuilding them from scratch. Does Optalitix replace our core systems? No. Optalitix sits between your models and your operational systems, integrating with PAS, CRM and data sources rather than replacing them. How long does Optalitix implementation take? Model deployment typically takes weeks (not years). Many clients move from spreadsheet model to live quoting capability in months. Is Optalitix secure and governed? Yes. Every model is version-controlled with full audit trails, approval workflows and role-based access, ensuring pricing decisions remain controlled and compliant. Can we still control underwriting decisions? Absolutely. Optalitix embeds underwriting rules, referrals and approval workflows alongside pricing logic, keeping humans in control of complex risks. Will your platform increase our IT burden? No. Optalitix replaces fragile spreadsheet processes with governed APIs, reducing shadow IT and simplifying integration across systems. One platform for the entire pricing lifecycle Bring all of your models and data together with full governance, ensuring your business can price confidently, consistently and at scale.
